scope: Factual design inventory of public Arc source and published CSS. No installed theme, adopted effect API, Pro component implementation, computed-style result, or accessibility certification.

notation.declarations: [immediate selector, source line, token, literal value]; source order retained. Outer media/support/container scope requires the linked source. Minified website CSS uses line 1.
notation.tokens: Unique literal var() references, not resolved or exhaustive dynamically assembled references.
notation.motion: Explicit motionTokens.group.name references; local constants, aliases and object-spread changes require manual source review.
notation.sizes: Foundation rem conversions in the companion document assume 16px base; these remain scalable rem values.
notation.website: Publicly served styles include demo-specific scoped themes and may include Pro preview paint. These are not private component implementation or universal theme defaults. Build asset URLs are mutable; captured hashes identify this observation.
